artifacts.name: low-level-design
artifacts.description: Full LLD for NFR-SEC-001: JSON import validation, threat model, validation architecture, 4 Mermaid sequence diagrams, 15 error codes, 22 test cases, ESLint enforcement rules. Merged to main via PR #45.

summary.work_completed: Low-Level Design for NFR-SEC-001 (JSON Import Validation & Arbitrary Code Execution Prevention) was authored and merged to main via PR #45. This retrigger (handoff 028) advances the pipeline to the frontend-test agent.
key_findings: LLD defines pure validation engine (jsonValidator.ts) with hand-rolled validator — no ajv dependency
Fail-fast strategy: FILE_TOO_LARGE, INVALID_JSON_SYNTAX, DEPTH_LIMIT_EXCEEDED, PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION all short-circuit immediately
Allowlist approach for all field values: catalogId, rotation, colors, IDs validated against strict patterns
structuredClone() + sanitizeString() breaks prototype chain before passing to sceneStore
22 test cases defined: 15 unit (T-FE-SEC-001-01 to 15), 4 integration (INT-01 to 04), 3 E2E (T-E2E-SEC-001-01 to 03)

human_review_required.item: OQ-1: Should zod be used instead of hand-rolled validator?
human_review_required.reason: zod may already be a project dependency; would reduce custom code

human_review_required.item: OQ-2: Exact set of valid catalogId values in BRICK_CATALOG
human_review_required.reason: Allowlist validation requires complete catalog enumeration

human_review_required.item: OQ-4: Should partial imports be allowed (skip invalid bricks)?
human_review_required.reason: Product decision affects error handling strategy
